name: Plane Sweep Volume (PSV)
definition: A 5D tensor X ∈ R^(D×V×3×H×W) obtained by projecting each input image I_v on each of the D depth planes. It encodes epipolar geometry between input views and the target view.
summary: Plane Sweep Volume is a 5D tensor encoding epipolar geometry by projecting input views onto depth planes, enabling efficient local processing by aligning adjacent camera rays.
